title: Dual-Review Attestation Schema
description: Strict dual-review attestation (SW1312-ATTESTATION-STRICT-001). A reusable, canonical contract that an SW1312 gate receipt validates against: one candidate_sha, exactly two diverse reviewer records (one Pro-class and one Flash-class), each binding reviewer_id, class, verdict and subject_sha, plus an explicit contradiction boolean. Full 40-hex SHAs are canonical lowercase. Unknown top-level and reviewer keys are rejected so a misspelled field such as contradiction_recorded can never be silently ignored.

candidate_sha.description: Canonical lowercase full 40-hex SHA of the candidate under attestation.

reviewers.description: Exactly two reviewer records, one Pro-class and one Flash-class.

contradiction.description: Explicit boolean. false = no material contradiction was recorded; a dual-review attestation with contradiction true never authorizes a gate.

reviewer_id.description: Distinct reviewer identity; two reviewers may not share an identity.

verdict.description: Exact verdict. A dual-review attestation exists only in the REVIEW_PASS shape.

subject_sha.description: Canonical lowercase full 40-hex SHA of the immutable subject the reviewer inspected; must equal candidate_sha.
